summary: Frontend-only visual + DOM test of GigLine dark-bg logo fix on Footer (homepage) and ClientIntakePage sticky nav. Both renders show the full 'GigLine' wordmark legibly in light/cream tone on dark backgrounds. Cache-bust ?v=3 confirmed in both attributes. Image loads (naturalWidth=1055, naturalHeight=503, complete=true). Canvas pixel analysis across 30 column samples shows 0 dark-only columns spanning the wordmark width — full 'GigLine' (G-i-g-L-i-n-e) renders consistently light/white-toned (most columns 220-250 brightness). Issue from iteration_18 (the 'Line' portion blending into navy) is fully resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.js logo block is fine; alt text and lazy loading set. Width/height attrs (240x86) don't match natural aspect (1055x503 ≈ 240x114) — minor: could cause slight visual layout reservation mismatch but doesn't affect display since w-auto + h-16 override.

ClientIntakePage.js is 793 lines — exceeds the 700-line threshold from code review guidelines. Consider splitting (e.g., extract S1-S7 sections, lane-expansion blocks, pricing display, validation) into smaller modules for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo file at /app/frontend/public/gigline-logo-dark-bg.png (217998 bytes, 1055x503 RGBA) renders all 7 GigLine letters in white. Cache-bust string ?v=3 is in Footer.js line 16 and ClientIntakePage.js line 344. Verified via Playwright on prod URL https://z-project-9.preview.emergentagent.com/ and /intake. Note: app routes ClientIntakePage at /intake (NOT /client-intake) per App.js.
rca of the issue: Original bug: previous logo file had 'Line' rendered in dark navy, blending into the #091725 footer background. Fix: restored an all-white-letters version at /app/frontend/public/gigline-logo-dark-bg.png and cache-busted via ?v=3 to force browsers to refetch. Verification confirmed via canvas pixel sampling — no dark columns remain within the wordmark area, and screenshots show the full 'GigLine' wordmark legible on both dark surfaces.
